source.actual_rule: Kalshi settlement value: the BLS first release for the reference month.
source.cutoff_rule: 08:20 America/New_York on the BLS release date
source.expectation_rule: Band midpoints; open tails one 50,000-job step beyond the last traded strike.
source.price_rule: Close of the last one-minute candle with traded volume in the 24 hours before the cutoff; weighted non-increasing fit across strikes.
